recognize_zh: 箭頭所指漿細胞的細胞核上可見一至數顆淡藍色、邊界清楚的圓形小體（Dutcher bodies），細胞質嗜鹼性、核偏位，背景為成熟中的顆粒球。
features: Plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei and abundant basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hof
One to several pale blue, sharply outlined round inclusions overlying the nucleus (Dutcher bodies, arrows)
Nuclear chromatin coarse with the inclusions appearing as clear-blue globules
Background of maturing granulocytes, an eosinophil, and scattered erythroid precursors
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows several plasma cells (arrows) with eccentric nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm. The nuclei contain one to several pale blue, round, well-circumscribed inclusions consistent with Dutcher bodies, which represent cytoplasmic immunoglobulin invaginated into or overlying the nucleus. The background includes maturing granulocytes, an eosinophil, and erythroid precursors. Dutcher bodies are associated with clonal plasmacytic proliferations, including plasma cell neoplasms and lymphoplasmacytic or marginal zone lymphomas.

ddx.vs: Russell bodies are cytoplasmic globules that fill the cytoplasm rather than sitting over the nucleus.
Nucleoli stain deeper blue-purple, are usually single and irregular, and lack the glassy pale-blue, sharply rounded appearance of Dutcher bodies.
Superimposed vacuoles are clear rather than pale blue and change focal plane relative to the nucleus; PAS positivity supports true Dutcher bodies.
